offer.name: Facebook Business Page Setup Sprint
offer.promise: Your Business Page details, drafted into the Facebook setup and settings forms you already have open. You read the plan in the side panel and click Approve & Commit before anything is created, saved, or posted.

rules.status: Labels, limits, and page signals are informed guesses until Phase 5 locks them against sanitized captures of the logged-in Page creation and settings views. Phase 5 also replaces these help-center roots with the specific articles the limits come from.
rules.binding: Controls are found by visible label, aria-label, or placeholder. Facebook does not publish input names and its class names change, so the shim never depends on either.
rules.scope: Business Pages only. Outside the Page creation view, the page must show the pack's Page name as a heading and at least one Page-admin signal, or the plan refuses with no actions.
rules.commit: Create Page, Save, the action-button Save, and Post are commit actions. They run only after Approve & Commit for this exact plan hash.
rules.media: Profile picture and cover photo are attached by the person. The shim tracks them as a checklist and, when the pack marks one required, blocks commit until the file input has a file.
rules.secrets: Packs never carry passwords, two-factor codes, or access tokens. A sign-in page is refused.

essentials.name: Facebook Business Page Setup Sprint: Essentials
essentials.promise: Page name, category, bio, and the main contact details, drafted into the Page form you have open. Nothing is created or saved until you click Approve & Commit.

standard.name: Facebook Business Page Setup Sprint: Standard Business
standard.promise: Everything in Essentials plus address, hours, and the action button, drafted into the Page forms you have open. Nothing is saved until you click Approve & Commit.

launch.name: Facebook Business Page Setup Sprint: Full Launch + Post
launch.promise: Everything in Standard Business plus a launch post drafted into the Page composer. Nothing is saved or posted until you click Approve & Commit.
